name: codex-security
description: OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security
one_liner: A tool that scans a company's codebase for security holes, checks whether each one is real (not a false alarm), and can write the fix itself.
buyer: A small software company's CTO who can't afford a dedicated security team but needs to pass a client's security questionnaire or SOC 2 audit.
business_use_cases: A boutique security consultancy uses it to run fast first-pass vulnerability scans for small-business clients before a manual pentest, cutting hours off every engagement.
A startup runs it in CI on every pull request so vulnerabilities get caught and patched before a release, instead of during an expensive post-incident scramble.
An MSP (managed service provider) adds 'ongoing AI security scanning' as a new line item for its small-business IT clients.

money_ideas.idea: Offer flat-fee 'AI security audit' reports for small businesses as a lead-in to larger security retainers
Run continuous scanning in CI as a monthly managed service for startups without in-house security staff

steal_this: Scan a few local small-business or client codebases this weekend, turn the findings into a one-page report, and offer a paid remediation sprint using the tool's patch generation.
